Question: assalamualaikum. I want to know that if i am going to makkah for umrah from india, can i make niyyat and offer two rakat from bombay in pant and shirt and wen i reach jeddah i will change my clothes and wear ihram on jeddah airport. is it right to do that? jzakallah Answer ID: 7780 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2028/319=TB/1429) You should wear Ihram clothes in Mumbai, offer two rakah salah and make intention of Ihram . It is not right what you have written. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
